backend/main.mo: Main backend actor handling access control, user approvals, admin allowlist checks, user profiles, and service reports with reset and permission-gated functions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module mapping old actor/user structures to new types, upgrading profiles, and producing a transformed state for upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality of various frontend files including hooks, components, pages, utilities, and deployment docs.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA as an Android TWA app using Bubblewrap or manual Android Studio setup with required PWA asset checks.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide covering local development, mainnet deployment, state-preserving upgrades, and post-deploy verification steps.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style layer defining OKLCH color tokens, light/dark mode variables, and base layout variables.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file defining root container and loading the main TypeScript entrypoint.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, colors, and icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling versioned precaching, runtime caching, activation, and fetch strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app setup configuring routes, authentication wrappers, query client, and layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user lacks permission, offering navigation back home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation bar with branding, navigation links, and authentication controls.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App-wide layout including header, banners, main content area, and footer with build info.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Gatekeeper component handling auth state, profile loading, login prompts, and error conditions.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a login screen component.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Displays a warning banner when the user is offline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: User profile creation form with validation and role-based signup logic.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Shows a banner when a service worker update is available and lets the user reload to apply it.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session error screen prompting the user to clear local state and return to sign‑in.
frontend/src/components/SignupPendingAcc: Shows an account‑activation pending screen with a retry button that refetches the user profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout flow that clears queries, storage, caches, and optionally reloads the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Captures the user’s geolocation with status tracking, errors, and optional auto‑capture.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login flow, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalActor.ts: Builds a backend actor using local-session identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalSessionAuth.t: Handles local session identities with storage persistence, login, logout, and auth state tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline browser network status via event listeners.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin status, and service reports via a local actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Implements a hook that detects service worker updates and lets the user apply them manually with page reload handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styles and color variables for light and dark themes with industrial color accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting, and resetting users with auth checks and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a selected service report with loading, error, and auth handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Provides a form for creating new service reports with validation, geolocation capture, and submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: A report history page that filters, searches, and downloads reports, handles auth errors, and supports copying user info.
frontend/src/utils/authClientIndexedDbCl: Clears known and discovered AuthClient-related IndexedDB databases to prevent automatic re-authentication.
frontend/src/utils/authClientPersistentL: Creates a fresh AuthClient instance and logs it out to clear persisted session state.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects whether an error is a genuine authentication failure versus missing profile or non-auth issues.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears all localStorage and sessionStorage as part of full auth/session reset.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates and exposes a build version identifier based on env variables or fallback logic.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Utility to copy text to the clipboard with modern and fallback methods.
frontend/src/utils/ensureNoInternetIdent: Runs cleanup routines to prevent Internet Identity from auto-restoring sessions.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Formats principal IDs and usernames for display and provides access to full values.
frontend/src/utils/localSessionIdentityS: Saves, loads, and clears a local Ed25519 session identity in localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears PWA caches and unregisters service workers during full system reset.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts DailyServiceReport arrays into CSV and triggers a browser download with a timestamped filename.
Maps backend signup errors to user-friendly messages and sanitizes technical or sensitive details.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized logging and error cleaning for signup/profile flow, redacting sensitive fields.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains basic validation helpers for required fields, email format, and mobile number rules.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles URL parameter extraction, session persistence, and cleanup for both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes project state, auth changes, admin provisioning tasks, known issues, and feature requests.
